title: A lizard in the hotel wall in Africa
summary: Bigard fled a hotel room when a large lizard came through the wall and was told it eats mosquitoes, then slept on a bar bench.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: Pierre Tallerie. here's Oh, I have something real funny. So we're in this nice hotel, a beautiful hotel. So I'm getting ready to go to bed and I see the wall. They had a hole in the wall over my head. I didn't pay any attention, you know. A nice hotel, you never think of nothing bad.

So almost -- I was getting ready to go to bed, and I see this big old thing coming through this hole, and I'm half stoned, so I got sober so fast. I got my clothes on so fast, was out there so fast -- out that room that is. Down in the lobby, I said, "They got a big animal up in my room." They said, "What is it?" I said, "About that long." "Oh," they said, "that's nothing. That's a lizard." I said, "What do you mean that's nothing, it's a lizard?" They said, "You ought to be happy he's in your room." I said, "Why?" They said, "He eats all the mosquitoes." I said, "Well, he's not going to eat the mosquitoes running all over my body." So I went right back in the bar and just stayed there and fell asleep on the bench in there.
In -- where is that -- chocolate country?
Cameroon is the French part. Just right on the Gold Coast.
